name: kimi-delegate
description: Delegate implementation tasks from Codex to Kimi Code through a local MCP bridge.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate Codex implementation tasks to Kimi Code.
interface.longDescription: A local bridge that lets Codex coordinate, review, and continue implementation tasks executed by Kimi Code.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the kimi-delegate tools when the user wants Codex to coordinate a software task while Kimi Code performs the implementation. Prepare a spec and plan, prefer `kimi_delegate_and_wait`, retain sessionId and promptId, and observe the same prompt with `kimi_wait_for_prompt` after a timeout. Never submit a continuation to a busy session unless deliberately queuing with allowQueue. Gather handoff and diff before acceptance. Before transferring workspace ownership, require terminationConfirmed from `kimi_abort_and_wait`; aborting a turn does not clear queued prompts. Do not auto-approve destructive commands.
